change: Extend existing native R2 fixture test with concurrent slice/resume coverage; no production changes.
assertions: First slices cross row-group boundaries and report rowOffset 13.
Resume through lake.resume(bookmark) returns exactly rows 13 through 99 with no further bookmark.
First slice data remains unchanged after resumed jobs and shared cache eviction.
Pool usage returns to zero after each completed group and cache eviction; tracked peak stays within cap.
limitations: Native R2 bindings in workerd test runtime; not a live deployed Cloudflare account.
Small fixture verifies lifecycle at configured caps, not near-cap concurrency headroom or total process heap.
Plain slice results are caller-managed after return; zero pool usage is not a claim that caller output consumes no RAM.
Explicitly owned slice output and bookmark normalization workspace remain open.

bookmarkTrace.normalizer: normalizeBookmarkQuery clones select/order terms, sorts projection/window records and retains nested expression references
bookmarkTrace.requiredOwnership: Own retained expression backing and admit output/sorting metadata before construction; outer object admission alone is insufficient.
